Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class LegalTrendController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.LegalTrendController
@Controller public class LegalTrendController extends Object
Thymeleaf controller that renders the legal trend analysis page.

Serves GET /dashboard/legal/trends by loading the latest LegalTrendSnapshot and populating the Thymeleaf model with rising legal/regulatory trend signals.

Tier gating: FREE users see only the top 3 trends; SUBSCRIBER, DEMO, and ADMIN users see all.
